description: Fix RL agent hold behavior. Run 9 failed: avg_bars=109, PF=0.07, t1_hit=0%. Run 10 uses strong hold_cost=-0.010 and t1_bonus=0.50 to force fast exits. Cap all trades at 50 bars max.

userStories.title: Update rl_config.py for Run 10 — strong hold cost + T1 bonus
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want Run 10 reward parameters set so that the RL agent is strongly penalized for holding and rewarded for hitting T1 targets.
acceptanceCriteria: A comment 'Run 10: strong-exit config' is present in the file
python3 -c 'from engine.strategies.rl_config import REWARD_CONFIG; assert REWARD_CONFIG["hold_cost"]==-0.010; assert REWARD_CONFIG["t1_bonus"]==0.50; print("OK")' succeeds
userStories.notes: Current values: hold_cost=-0.002, t1_bonus=0.20 (from Run 9). Run 9 generated 109-bar avg holds and 0% T1 hit rate — agent learned to never act. Strong penalties needed.

userStories.title: Add MAX_BARS_IN_TRADE=50 hard limit to rl_environment.py
userStories.description: As a risk manager, I want positions force-closed after 50 bars so that the RL agent cannot hold positions indefinitely regardless of learned behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: step() method force-closes position when bars_in_trade >= MAX_BARS_IN_TRADE
info dict contains 'forced_close': True when hard limit triggered
Forced close applies the exit penalty from REWARD_CONFIG
All existing RL tests pass (no regressions)
userStories.notes: Run 9 generated 109-bar avg holds. Without a hard cap the agent can hold for 100-200 bars even with strong hold_cost. 50-bar cap aligns with 1-session RTH window.

userStories.title: Update rl_evaluator.py to report avg_bars and t1_hit_rate gates
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want the evaluator to explicitly check the Run 10 gates so I can see pass/fail at a glance after training.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/strategies/rl_evaluator.py reports avg_bars_in_trade in evaluation output
engine/strategies/rl_evaluator.py reports t1_hit_rate in evaluation output
Gate check: avg_bars_in_trade < 50 logged as PASS/FAIL

userStories.notes: Currently evaluator reports basic metrics. Adding explicit gate reporting makes Run 10 evaluation self-documenting.
